messages:
maria: Quick alert 1 — recorder didn't capture the first minute, control panel shows 'encoder offline'. Can AV team check room B capture box? I'm going to delay start by ~6m.
ben-stream: Seeing encoder watchdog error on obs-node-7, node lost connection to RTMP endpoint.
sasha: On standby outside room B. @ops can you confirm whether the backup H.264 encoder is online?
owns: Backup encoder (hw-enc-2) is up but waiting for HDMI switch. Pinging on-call to confirm cable.
lars: If we have a small delay, can we flip the roadmap and Q&A order? I can take a short intro while you fix recording.
courtney: Prefer to keep roadmap first but we can shorten it to 6m and move the audience poll later. Also need captions on for accessibility.
captions-bot: Caption service disconnected (Skyline): reconnect attempts ongoing.
ops: Skyline acknowledged. Ticket INC-7839 opened. Spinner ETA 7m. Spawning an RTMP fallback to YouTube now. If required, use fallback command: 
```
obs-cli switch-profile "AH-Fallback" && obs-cli start-stream --rtmp rtmp://a.rtmp.youtube.com/live2/XXXXX
```
ben-stream: HDMI patched to hw-enc-2. Starting local OBS capture, monitoring levels. Mic 2 peaking, applying -4dB.
maria: Thanks. If we can't confirm archive within 10m, we'll do the live Q&A now and record slides separately. OK? :hand_wave:
sasha: Fine by me. I'll prep a note in the shared agenda doc and DM a two-minute heads up.
lars: I'll compress roadmap slides, dropping deep-dive numbers. Send me the shortened notes.
ops: Captioner manual standby available, joining in ~90s to provide live captions until Skyline returns. Also toggled extended retention on fallback archive.
ben-stream: Recording now running on local-obs-node-7. Local archive will upload to S3 after meeting.
maria: Great. Please add action item: verify OBS auto-start and encoder watchdog for next all-hands (adding to infra runbook). Starting in 2m for a short Q&A-first agenda.
courtney: Noted. I'll update the agenda and create the poll to fire at the end. :white_check_mark:
thread_text_snippet: recorder didn't capture the first minute, control panel shows 'encoder offline'
